title: UFC 334 faceoff: Kayla Harrison, Amanda Nunes exchange serious stares in Times Square
text:
UFC 334 faceoff: Kayla Harrison, Amanda Nunes exchange serious stares in Times Square Videos Blue Corner Schedule Results Rankings Fighters A.S. 1980-2025 💙 Newsletter UFC UFC 334 faceoff: Kayla Harrison, Amanda Nunes exchange serious stares in Times Square
 Mike Bohn MMA Junkie Nov. 10, 2026, 6:08 p.m. ET NEW YORK – The big stars of UFC 334 came face-to-face in one of the world's most famous tourist destinations.
 With fight week activities now underway, the main and co-main event title fight competitors faced off at Times Square on Tuesday evening. UFC 334 co-main eventers Kayla Harrison and Amanda Nunes got within arm's reach of each other as they squared off at one of New York City's most popular attractions.
 The two have known each other for some time, and now they are just days away from fighting in one of the biggest women's fights of all time. Harrison (19-1 MMA, 3-0 UFC), with the women's bantamweight title draped over her shoulder, got inches away from Nunes (23-5 MMA, 16-2 UFC), and they exchanged intense stares in front of a gathering of fans.
